SELECT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM usage_projection_history h
 JOIN usage_projection_contributions c ON c.scope_id=h.scope_id AND c.generation=h.generation AND c.work_key=h.work_key
 JOIN usage_projection_applied a ON a.scope_id=c.scope_id AND a.generation=c.generation AND a.work_key=c.work_key AND a.build_id=c.build_id
 WHERE h.scope_id=$1 AND h.generation=$2 AND h.lifetime_count>0 AND h.dated_count>0
 AND c.coverage_kind<>'lifetime' AND  c.scope_id=$3 AND c.generation=$4 AND c.provider=$5)
 OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM usage_projection_contributions c JOIN usage_projection_applied a

 WHERE  c.scope_id=$6 AND c.generation=$7 AND c.provider=$8 AND c.coverage_kind IN ('calendar','interval'))

SELECT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM usage_daily_summaries c WHERE  c.scope_id=$1 AND c.generation=$2 AND c.provider=$3 AND c.calendar='UTC' AND c.source<>'native')
 OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM usage_daily_summaries c WHERE  c.scope_id=$4 AND c.generation=$5 AND c.provider=$6 AND c.calendar='UTC'
 GROUP BY c.model,c.provider HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.metric_kind='cost' THEN c.currency END)>1)
 OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM usage_daily_summaries c WHERE  c.scope_id=$7 AND c.generation=$8 AND c.provider=$9 AND c.calendar='UTC'
 GROUP BY c.model,c.provider,c.usage_date,c.actor_id,c.actor_status,c.actor_kind,c.source,c.agent_client,c.semantics

        SUM(CASE WHEN c.metric_kind='cost' THEN c.cost_count ELSE 0 END))
